subject: Ice Cold Startup News from Helsinki ❄

stories.headline: Iconic raises €9.1M seed for AI operating system for infrastructure projects
stories.quote: Amsterdam-based Iconic raised €9.1 million in Seed funding to develop an AI operating system for large-scale infrastructure, energy and construction projects.
stories.description: AI operating system for large infrastructure, energy and construction projects

stories.headline: Fermat secures €7.26M for AI platform for fashion and luxury brands
stories.quote: Fermat , based in Barcelona, secured €7.26 million to expand its AI platform for fashion and luxury brands, including plans to open an office in New York.
stories.description: AI platform for fashion and luxury brands

stories.headline: Valeria raises €5.5M to automate payroll and workforce management
stories.quote: Barcelona-based HR technology startup Valeria raised €5.5 million to automate payroll and workforce management for businesses with high employee turnover.
stories.description: HR technology automating payroll and workforce management

stories.headline: RHISE AI lands €2.66M for privacy-focused European personal AI assistant
stories.quote: Munich-based RHISE AI landed €2.66 million to develop a privacy-focused European personal AI assistant.
stories.description: Privacy-focused European personal AI assistant

stories.headline: AI-native law firm Alecto secures €18M
stories.quote: British AI-native law firm Alecto secured €18 million to expand its AI-powered legal services beyond property transactions and support international growth.
stories.description: AI-native law firm offering AI-powered legal services

stories.headline: Perry AI raises €2M for AI legal intelligence for PE and VC funds
stories.quote: London LegalTech startup Perry AI raised €2 million to bring AI-powered legal intelligence and automation to private equity and venture capital funds.
stories.description: AI-powered legal intelligence and automation for PE and VC funds

stories.headline: Disseqt AI raises €7.3M for AI governance and assurance platform
stories.quote: Ireland-based Disseqt AI raised €7.3 million in a round to scale its AI governance and assurance platform, helping enterprises safely deploy and manage AI agents.
stories.description: AI governance and assurance platform for enterprises deploying AI agents

stories.headline: LATO raises €4.28M seed to automate commercial due diligence with AI agents
stories.quote: London-based, Y Combinator-backed LATO raised €4.28 million in Seed funding to automate commercial due diligence using AI agents, helping investors accelerate research and investment decisions.
stories.description: AI agents automating commercial due diligence for investors

stories.headline: Mistral AI secures additional €100M from Deutsche Telekom's T.Capital Tech Fund, adding to its Series D
stories.quote: Paris-based AI unicorn Mistral AI secured an additional €100 million from Deutsche Telekom's T.Capital Tech Fund, adding to its €3 billion Series D to accelerate sovereign AI adoption across European industries.
stories.description: AI unicorn working on sovereign AI adoption across European industries

stories.headline: Mistral AI's €3B Series D, cited as the round the new €100M adds to

stories.description: AI unicorn working on sovereign AI adoption across European industries

stories.headline: Vetaion raises €5.7M pre-seed for AI-powered robotic manufacturing of electrical control cabinets
stories.quote: Munich-based Vetaion raised €5.7 million in pre-Seed funding to scale its AI-powered robotic manufacturing of electrical control cabinets, reducing production times and dependence on manual labour.
stories.description: AI-powered robotic manufacturing of electrical control cabinets

stories.headline: MountAIn raises €7.3M seed to bring AI to ultra-low-cost microcontrollers
stories.quote: MountAIn , based in Grenoble, raised €7.3 million in Seed funding to bring advanced AI capabilities to ultra-low-cost microcontrollers, making intelligent devices more affordable and energy-efficient.
stories.description: Advanced AI capabilities for ultra-low-cost microcontrollers

stories.headline: Daisytuner secures €6M to optimise AI model performance across chip architectures
stories.quote: Darmstadt-based Daisytuner secured €6 million to optimise AI model performance across NVIDIA, AMD and emerging chip architectures, reducing dependence on individual hardware providers.
stories.description: Optimises AI model performance across NVIDIA, AMD and emerging chips

stories.headline: Payhawk raises €255.14M at a €1.82B valuation
stories.quote: Bulgarian-founded FinTech unicorn Payhawk , based in London, raised €255.14 million, reaching a €1.82 billion valuation, as it builds an AI-native global finance operating system.
stories.description: FinTech unicorn building an AI-native global finance operating system

stories.headline: Model ML secures €227M at a €1.3B valuation
stories.quote: London-based Model ML secured €227 million at a €1.3 billion valuation, becoming one of Europe's newest unicorns as it scales AI agents for financial institutions and professional services.
stories.description: AI agents for financial institutions and professional services

stories.headline: Previsia raises €3.8M seed for AI-powered risk prevention platform
stories.quote: Toulouse’s InsurTech Previsia raised €3.8 million in Seed funding to expand its AI-powered risk prevention platform and accelerate its growth across European insurance markets.
stories.description: InsurTech with an AI-powered risk prevention platform

stories.headline: Plural raises €1B to back European founders in frontier technologies
stories.quote: London-based venture capital firm Plural raised €1 billion, targeting ambitious European founders working in frontier technologies, including AI, energy and DeepTech.
stories.description: Venture capital firm backing European frontier technology founders
stories.fund_focus: frontier technologies, including AI, energy and DeepTech

stories.headline: Isomorphic Labs raises €4.5B Series C for AI-designed drug pipeline
stories.quote: AI drug discovery startup Isomorphic Labs raised a blockbuster €4.5 billion in Series C funding to advance its AI-designed drug pipeline towards clinical trials and accelerate the development of new medicines.
stories.description: AI drug discovery startup

stories.headline: Commit Biologics secures €54M seed for next-generation immunotherapies
stories.quote: Copenhagen-based Commit Biologics secured €54 million in Seed funding to advance next-generation immunotherapies targeting cancer and autoimmune diseases.
stories.description: Next-generation immunotherapies for cancer and autoimmune diseases

stories.headline: Treat raises €3M pre-seed for AI-assisted private healthcare intake and consultations
stories.quote: Helsinki’s Treat , co-founded by Swappie's former CEO, raised €3 million in pre-Seed funding to streamline private healthcare through AI-assisted patient intake and medical consultations.
stories.description: AI-assisted patient intake and medical consultations for private healthcare

stories.headline: IntelliProve raises €2.7M seed for vital-sign measurement by facial scan
stories.quote: Ghent-based IntelliProve raised €2.7 million in Seed funding to scale its technology that measures vital signs, including heart rate and blood pressure, through a 30-second facial scan through a smartphone or laptop.
stories.description: Measures vital signs through a 30-second facial scan

stories.headline: Stark Future raises more than €150M at a €1.2B pre-money valuation
stories.quote: Barcelona-based electric motorcycle manufacturer Stark Future raised more than €150 million at a €1.2 billion pre-money valuation, strengthening its position as Europe's first electric motorcycle unicorn.
stories.description: Electric motorcycle manufacturer

stories.headline: Intergrid announces €23.5M in funding for autonomous energy management technology
stories.quote: Helsinki-based EnergyTech company Intergrid announced €23.5 million in funding to scale its autonomous energy management technology for industrial operations internationally.
stories.description: Autonomous energy management technology for industrial operations

stories.headline: Elysian Aircraft secures over €12M in equity and public funding for battery-electric aviation
stories.quote: Dutch aerospace startup Elysian Aircraft secured over €12 million in equity and public funding to advance battery-electric aviation technologies for commercial and defence applications.
stories.description: Battery-electric aviation technologies for commercial and defence applications
